notes.title: Version 1.0 Live
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that todays update takes us to release version 1.0. It includes the final image scenes that were missing and as usual we have fixed all reported bugs on the discussion hub.

We now consider the game completed and ready for full release on steam and on other platforms. As all images and content have now been implemented.

We are very happy that we continued to work on the game to make something we can be proud of that keeps within it;

* Character Creation
* An open map to explore
* Freedom of choice
* Multiple epilogues based on your actions
* Multiple endings
* Romance

And lots more besides. We hope you all enjoy the game.

[b][i]N.b. Lastly, please be aware that at the start of July we will be increasing the games price to its full price we plan to release the game on, and then the game will officially leave Early Access on July 6th.[/i][/b]

notes.title: Hard Night - Achievements
notes.notes:
Today we are uploading a much larger update than I expected for the game, as noted yesterday I thought that updates would slow down, when in fact they have sped up.

To explain yesterday my wife became a little ill and as such all my plans for the day where thrown out and so whilst making sure she was all right I worked on Starlight Drifter.

I ended up doing a power session, working on it all day yesterday, most of the night and then today as well... To the point where the game is now 99.9999% finished. That is to say everything has been included in this update with the exception of just two images, which will be added as soon as the artist completes them in the next couple of days.

This update to version 0.99.99 adds:
[list]
    [*]44 Fully Functional Achievements in Steam
    [*]Steam Achievements have been activated
    [*]All known & reported bugs and issues fixed
    [*]Save Game Names Added based on area of the game
    [*]All endings and epilogues added
[/list]

In addition to the updates to the game that make this the final version (minus the final image set as mentioned) we have also completed the Steam Trading Card designs and have submitted those cards to Steam for approval. 

Based on all of this we have now set a full release date of Starlight Drifter for Friday 6th July 2018. The next main update for the game will be taking it to version 1.0 (by adding the missing images mentioned above).

If however you find a bug in the game, please post it on the discussion hub and we will fix those and post mini updates resolving them.

As such we can now focus on the larger items to implement such as the Achievements and Trading Cards for the game.

[b]Todays update includes:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Rana gender swap illustration bug corrected.
    [*]Several small dialogue text errors resolved
    [*]Main Menu Gallery Updated with all images
    [*]Main Menu Gallery Altered to suit all image sets
    [*]All illustrations and Sprites fully implemented
[i](with the exception of one for the games main epilogue/ending
 - Which is in production now for release in the coming days)[/i]
[/list]

From now on there may not be a daily update to the game itself, but there will be an update of some kind so you know what we are working on and implementing each day. From now on there will only be a game update for Starlight Drifter when we resolve any new bugs that are reported on the discussions hub, implement the full achievements section, add the last image to the game or add a key feature.

notes.title: Version 0.99.04
notes.notes:
The latest update for Starlight Drifter is now live, this corrects several issues with the Koria character and relationship with her on board the ship.

First it corrects an error that occasionally occurs when you meet her, whereby she would not appear on the starlight as a crew member afterwards.

Please note that while we have corrected this bug, if you have already gone past this point in the game Koria will not suddenly appear, instead if you play the mission where she appears from this point on the bug will not occur and she will join the crew as normal.

In addition once this was resolved we found some missing sprite images of Koria and so we also fixed these issues in this update.

notes.title: Version 0.99.03
notes.notes:
Today's update is technically a small one, but an important one.

Today we have implemented an update that resolves all known Sprite Error bugs, that are generally called 'paper cutout' bugs. This is a bug where instead of a character sprite appearing a flat siloutte default image appears instead.

This update resolves all known and reported paper cutout sprite errors.
As well as other sprite errors within the game.
Allowing us to focus on other aspects such as the games Achievements and Trading Cards.

[i]If after this point you encounter any errors with character sprites, paper cutout or otherwise please report them on the community hub. When doing so please also quote a line of text from the dialogue box, so that we can properly match the error within the thousands of lines of code that make up the game, for a quicker resolution of the error. But hopefully there will be none after this point.[/i]

[b][i]Remember the current version 0.99.03 will appear on the main menu, ensure the game is up to date before reporting an error, to prevent us looking for an error that was already resolved.[/i][/b]

notes.title: Version 0.99
notes.notes:
Version 0.99 is now live.

We have worked hard over the past few months, updating the game and trying to ensure as much of the original plans remain within the game.

Whilst we did have to make some compromises here and there, most of the games main features remain intact:

1. Character Creation Remains
2. Crew Romances Remain
3. Open World Story Telling Remain

Essentially we have edited the entire script, written extra content where needed and fully coded the game with backgrounds, character sprites and even cg illustrations. 

[h1][b]Warning: This update will break all existing save games,
so please delete them and start the game fresh to avoid game crashes![/b][/h1]

There are still a few things to fix and a few more illustrations to add, but the game we believe is stable and as we stated before 99% complete.

We will continue to post smaller updates with remaining art scenes, bug fixes and additional content over the coming weeks in preparation for the games full release.

In addition we will be looking to launch the games steam achievements and trading cards very soon as well.

notes.title: Starlight Drifter Lives Again
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that Starlight Drifter is once again live.

Version 0.99 of the game will be available for existing players in mere moments and the Steam Store Page is live in Early Access Mode.

[h1][b]Warning: This update will break all existing save games,
so please delete them and start the game fresh to avoid game crashes![/b][/h1]

The new version includes 99% of all content complete, with most game issues fixed, new artwork added, new storylines added, game endings added, the game has been fundamentally updated and is now fully playable.

Well what can we say the game is mostly complete.
Hence version 0.99

Early Access will continue on for the next 2-6 weeks:

During that time we will be focusing on;
[list]
    [*]Adding in Remaining Illustration Scenes
    [*]Fixing Bugs Reported on Community Hub
    [*]Adding Steam Achievements
    [*]Fixing Save Name Known Issue
    [*]Fixing the Gallery.
[/list]

We believe we can resolve all these final issues during this final Early Access period and move towards a release in July or August 2018.

[b]1. Dramatically altered the introduction of the game.[/b]

notes.title: Update 14 - Reversion, Dedication & apologies
notes.notes:
Greetings,

Today we are reverting the game back to a previous update, update #14. Which will see a variety of content being reintroduced to the game, we will also be looking to use this as a basis moving forward.

I (Dharker Himself) will be taking over development of this game, and I will be looking to dedicate my time to it until it is finished, I will be doing weekly updates, you an expect to see save breaking updates pretty much every week for the for-seeable future as I rewrite the script whilst coding changes.

My aim is simple, create what I wanted Starlight Drifter to be when it was started two years ago, I hope you will all come along for the ride.

That being said, I have also requested steam re-add the Refunds anytime for anyone who wants to jettison themselves and come back to it when its out of early access, I do not know when that will be other than when the game is ready. I will advise in a future update when that option is live once more.

This isn't a changelog as such, but here are my notes on changes:

1. Re-added gender select
2. Re-added character creation (hair, eyes, clothing, stance)
3. Re-added scripting as of update 14.

Thank you, next update is next week.

notes.title: Hiatus/Retirement
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone,

It is with a heavy heart that we are announcing Starlight Drifters temporary retirement/hiatus from development. For some time now we have had some difficulties developing this title. Developers disappearing, personal issues, artwork delays and an abundance of other issues.

Over the past couple of months we have been going over the script and we have come to the decision that the game needs to be reworked from scratch, and made into a proper game.

To do this we have decided to remove the game from Steam for the time being, the game will technically be retired (Store page removed) no longer purchasable. But we will consider it on Hiatus while we find a new writer to rebuild the game from scratch, when the game is then ready we will relaunch it.

If however we fail to redevelop it, then in the not to distant future we will instead give everyone who owns this game a copy of a different stand alone space sci fi title in the same vein as Starlight Drifter was going to be instead.

Thank you for the support and we hope things finally come together and we see you all agaain soon with a better title for you to enjoy.

P.s. The game will remain in your steam account permanently set on the last version of Early Access, until we are able to re-launch in the future.

notes.title: Captains Log: Early Access
notes.notes:
We are soon to boldly go where we have never gone before, taking one of our largest titles into early access.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/326060/

Starlight Drifter has been in development for the past two years, during which we have seen artists come and go and over 250,000 words of scripting created for the game.

For the final stretch of development we want to give the game every possible chance, so we are set to release the latest builds on Early Access later today, with our aim to complete the title for a final release before the end of the year.

By picking up the game during Early Access you will get several benefits... First you will be able to help us shape the game, not only by posting bug reports but also by suggesting new content to add via the community hub. In addition to which we will also have the game at a substantial discount while it is in Early Access and a further 20% discount on top of that for its opening week.

And so our great campaign begins.
Please visit our Community Hub Discussions for more information on what we are doing and what you can expect from the game during Early Access.

notes.title: Capt Log: M1.20160517.14.23
notes.notes:
Today's update sees the addition of character sprites and more artwork to the games intro sequence.

In addition we have put more work into the art animations for the first third of the intro sequence and removed unnecessary and boring dialogue sections in order to make the intro more enjoyable.

We have also removed variable errors at the end of the intro.
I expect that the intro will be completed in its entirety by tomorrow's update.

After which we will be coding the 55 already scripted events into the game, as well as look at the possibility of adding crew dialogue before we release on Early Access later this week.

notes.title: Capt. Log: M1.20160516.20.34
notes.notes:
A large update today, I still have not added more artwork, instead focusing my time on developing the sandbox galaxy map, as well as the options to explore the Starlight vessel in between missions.

Currently a variety of variables have been set in a bad state for testing purposes, which will likely be fixed tomorrow. I advise noone to save the game before Early Access officially begins in a week or two time.

This update has added the galaxy screen, with all 55 unique events coded into the games sandbox galaxy map. Which is reachable from the captains quarters.

In addition the games internal view of the ship is now visible. Instead of selecting a crew member to speak to, you will be able to explore the ship, our aim will be to give each room a set of optional things to do.

Crew chats are still to be implemented as are the actual galaxy events. Dialogue boxes for events also need to be fixed as currently showing up badly.

My aim will be to add all of the games events into the game in a functional format albeit purely as text this week, as well as adding a basic form of crew interaction and ship options.
